h1: Rent reusable plastic moving crates for your office move
lead: Commercial-grade plastic crates, delivered clean and collected when your move is done. No cardboard to buy, assemble, tape or dispose of.
card_blurb: Reusable commercial-grade plastic crates, delivered clean and collected after your move.
meta_title: Rent Plastic Moving Crates for Offices | BRS
meta_description: Rent reusable commercial-grade plastic moving crates for offices, schools and businesses. Delivery, pickup scheduling and flexible terms from BRS.
overview: Business Relocation Services (BRS) rents reusable plastic moving crates to offices, schools, healthcare organizations and other businesses. Crates arrive clean and ready to use, and we collect them once your move is complete.
Plastic crates are sturdy, stackable and weather resistant. They protect documents, electronics and equipment, and they remove the work of buying, assembling, taping and disposing of cardboard boxes.
Rentals are planned around your timeline, from a few days to several weeks. We help you work out how many crates you need and when.

benefits.title: Faster, more organized moves
benefits.text: Labeled, stackable crates speed up packing and unpacking and make it easier to sort departments, files and equipment. Teams settle into the new space sooner.

benefits.title: Less waste
benefits.text: Reusable crates reduce waste compared with disposable cardboard. Each crate can be reused many times.

benefits.title: Flexible rental terms
benefits.text: Short-term and long-term rentals, with quantities based on the size of your move.

included: Smooth interiors and moisture and weather resistance
Cleaned and sanitized crates before delivery
Custom quantities based on move size
Help estimating how many crates you need

process.title: Estimate quantities
process.text: Tell us about your offices, staff or rooms. We help estimate how many crates you need and when.

process.title: Schedule delivery
process.text: We deliver clean, ready-to-use crates to your location on the agreed date.

process.title: Pack and label
process.text: Your team packs and labels crates by department, file or equipment type.

process.title: Collect after the move
process.text: Once the move is complete, we pick the crates up. Nothing to assemble or dispose of.

who_for: Short-term in-house projects such as renovations, clean-outs, re-stacks and staff shifts

faq.q: How many moving crates do I need?
faq.a: It depends on the size of your move. We can help estimate the quantity based on the number of offices, employees or rooms involved.

faq.q: How long can I rent crates for?
faq.a: Rental periods are flexible, from a few days to several weeks, with short-term and long-term options.

faq.q: Are the crates cleaned before delivery?
faq.a: Yes. All crates are cleaned and sanitized before delivery.

faq.q: Do you deliver in New York City?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver and collect crates throughout New York City and surrounding areas. We also have partner warehouses in 19 locations nationally. For pricing, email rent_crates@brsrelocations.com.
